hypotheses.claim: H-BPP-001-priority-residual: replacing pure size-descending priority with a composite score_item that mixes item size (descending, BFD-like) with a residual-capacity-structure term will reduce bin count versus size-descending first-fit when repacking, because ordering large-but-awkward items (those leaving hard-to-fill residuals) first minimizes residual-capacity fragmentation in the open bins.

next_search_advice.direction: Enrich the offline item-priority `score_item` from the pure size-descending control (BFD-like) into a composite score: w1*(normalized item size) + w2*(residual-capacity fit tightness term computed against the multiset of open-bin residuals) + w3*(awkwardness proxy for items whose size lies just above/k=2,3 resonant fractions of capacity), with a deterministic best-fit (minimum feasible residual) placement rule inside the repack pass and a descending-size tie-break. Keep the whole procedure O(n log n + n * #bins) so it stays far inside the 500 ms budget (round-1 used only 0.215 ms/solve).
